candidates.text: TODAY'S HEARING IS ON DOCKET 1718 ORDER REGARDING A TEXT AMENDMENT TO THE BOSTON ZONING CODE TO PROHIBIT DATA CENTERS IN ALL ZONING DISTRICTS.

I FOLLOWED THE ZONING AMENDMENT BECAUSE AS DATA CENTERS CONTINUE TO EXPAND ACROSS MASSACHUSETTS AND THE COUNTRY, I BELIEVE BOSTON NEEDS TO DECIDE PROACTIVELY WHETHER THIS IS AN APPROPRIATE LAND USE FOR OUR CITY, WHETHER

WE'VE ALSO SEEN COMMUNITIES LIKE LOWELL RAISE CONCERNS ABOUT NOISE, AIR POLLUTION, BACKUP DIESEL GENERATORS AND THE LACK OF MEANINGFUL COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT IN DECISIONS ABOUT DATA CENTER DEVELOPMENT.

THAT IS WHY THIS AMENDMENT PROPOSES DEFINING DATA CENTERS ,ENFORCING ZONING CODE AND MAKING THEM OF A BUILDING USE CITYWIDE WHILE PROTECTING ORDINARY SERVER ROOMS COMPUTER INFRASTRUCTURE THAT SUPPORT EXISTING BUSINESSES,
AS I AS I UNDERSTAND IT, DEVELOPERS MUST NOW SECURE FOR LOCAL APPROVAL IN A COMMUNITY BENEFITS AGREEMENT BEFORE ANY PERMIT STATE.
UM AND I SHOULD SAY IS APPROVED.
